# datadog_flaky_tests_management_policies (Resource)

Provides a Datadog Flaky Tests Management policies resource. This can be used to configure the flaky test lifecycle policies (quarantine, disable, attempt to fix) for a repository. Note: the API does not support deleting policies; removing the resource from your configuration stops managing it but leaves the policies in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure flaky test management policies for a repository

resource "datadog_flaky_tests_management_policies" "my_repo" {
  repository_id = "github.com/my-org/my-repo"

  attempt_to_fix {
    retries = 5
  }

  quarantined {
    enabled = true

    auto_quarantine_rule {
      enabled        = true
      window_seconds = 1209600
    }

    branch_rule {
      enabled                = true
      branches               = ["main"]
      excluded_branches      = ["release/*"]
      excluded_test_services = ["my-legacy-service"]
    }

    failure_rate_rule {
      enabled   = true
      branches  = ["main"]
      min_runs  = 10
      threshold = 0.3
    }
  }

  disabled {
    enabled = true

    auto_disable_rule {
      enabled        = true
      status         = "quarantined"
      window_seconds = 2592000
    }

    branch_rule {
      enabled  = true
      branches = ["main"]
    }

    failure_rate_rule {
      enabled   = true
      branches  = ["main"]
      min_runs  = 10
      status    = "quarantined"
      threshold = 0.5
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `repository_id` (String) The repository identifier (e.g. `github.com/org/repo`).

### Optional

- `attempt_to_fix` (Attributes) Configuration for the attempt-to-fix Flaky Tests Management policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attempt_to_fix))
- `disabled` (Attributes) Configuration for the disabled Flaky Tests Management policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disabled))
- `quarantined` (Attributes) Configuration for the quarantined Flaky Tests Management policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--quarantined))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--attempt_to_fix"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attempt_to_fix`

Optional:

- `retries` (Number) Number of retries when attempting to fix a flaky test. Must be greater than 0.


<a id="nestedatt--disabled"></a>
### Nested Schema for `disabled`

Optional:

- `auto_disable_rule` (Attributes) Automatic disable triggering rule based on a time window and test status. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disabled--auto_disable_rule))
- `branch_rule` (Attributes) Branch filtering rule for the disabled policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disabled--branch_rule))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the disabled policy is enabled.
- `failure_rate_rule` (Attributes) Failure-rate-based rule for the disabled policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disabled--failure_rate_rule))

<a id="nestedatt--disabled--auto_disable_rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `disabled.auto_disable_rule`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this auto-disable rule is enabled.
- `status` (String) Test status that the disable policy applies to. Valid values are `active`, `quarantined`.
- `window_seconds` (Number) Time window in seconds over which flakiness is evaluated. Must be greater than 0.


<a id="nestedatt--disabled--branch_rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `disabled.branch_rule`

Optional:

- `branches` (Set of String) List of branches to which the policy applies.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this branch rule is enabled.
- `excluded_branches` (Set of String) List of branches excluded from the policy.
- `excluded_test_services` (Set of String) List of test services excluded from the policy.


<a id="nestedatt--disabled--failure_rate_rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `disabled.failure_rate_rule`

Optional:

- `branches` (Set of String) List of branches to which this rule applies.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this failure rate rule is enabled.
- `min_runs` (Number) Minimum number of runs required before the rule is evaluated. Must be greater than or equal to 0.
- `status` (String) Test status that the disable policy applies to. Valid values are `active`, `quarantined`.
- `threshold` (Number) Failure rate threshold (0.0-1.0) above which the rule triggers.

Optional:

- `auto_quarantine_rule` (Attributes) Automatic quarantine triggering rule based on a time window. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--quarantined--auto_quarantine_rule))
- `branch_rule` (Attributes) Branch filtering rule for the quarantined policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--quarantined--branch_rule))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the quarantined policy is enabled.
- `failure_rate_rule` (Attributes) Failure-rate-based rule for the quarantined policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--quarantined--failure_rate_rule))

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Flaky Tests Management policies can be imported using the repository ID. For example:
terraform import datadog_flaky_tests_management_policies.my_repo github.com/my-org/my-repo
```
